quiz.question: Which sign-in is true multi-factor authentication?
options: Password and a code from an authenticator app
quiz.answer_text: Password and a code from an authenticator app
quiz.why: MFA needs factors of different types. A password and a PIN or security question are both "something you know"; the app code is "something you have".
